definitions.explanation: The process of constructing buildings or infrastructure.

examples.japanese: {建設|けんせつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧
{建設|けんせつ}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work at a construction site.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建設|けんせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a plan to construct a new hospital in this area.

notes:
{建設|けんせつ} refers to large-scale construction of buildings, infrastructure, and public works. It emphasizes the overall project of building something substantial.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {建設|けんせつ}{中|ちゅう}: under construction
- {建設|けんせつ}{会社|がいしゃ}: construction company
- {建設|けんせつ}{現場|げんば}: construction site
- {建設|けんせつ}{業|ぎょう}: construction industry
- {建設|けんせつ}{費|ひ}: construction costs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {建設|けんせつ}: large-scale construction (roads, dams, buildings)
- {建築|けんちく}: architecture, building design and construction (focuses on individual buildings)
- {建造|けんぞう}: construction of large structures (ships, bridges)
- {工事|こうじ}: construction work (the physical labor/process)

USAGE:
Can be used figuratively: {国家|こっか}{建設|けんせつ} (nation-building), {建設的|けんせつてき}な{意見|いけん} (constructive opinion).
